issues.reason: The Existential section reserves the bare class symbol for a non-specific / generic object (the 'brought in restrictions' -> (Patient e restriction) precedent) and reserves a witness for 'a/an' / 'some'; minting sk_suitor_1 inside an occurrence-neutral purpose clause asserts that some undesired suitor exists, which the text does not state, and loses the plural.

As the reviewer's own third gap concedes, a bare noun-noun sequence with a proper-noun possessor is uncovered — the possessive section is licensed for 's, possessive pronouns and of-phrases, and the naming rule's lowercase-common-noun route ('the Brindle estuary') would wrongly type PeopleSoft itself as management — and (Possession sk_management_1 peoplesoft) is explicitly opaque, covering 'looser association' without asserting anything false or ill-typed.

The predicative 'as'-complement of 'known as' has no licensed encoding (the reviewer files this as a gap), the parse coins no participle head, and (Member sk_defense_1 poison_pill) is true and well-typed of an anti-takeover defense that is a poison pill — improvisation in gap territory, not a defect.

gaps_confirmed: appellation post-modifier 'known as / called <NP>' — the reduced-relative rule demands an event but no encoding is licensed for the predicative 'as' complement, and an indefinite class label is not a Name string
'could' is absent from the modal sense-map (must -> Must/Obligated, may -> Might/Permitted, can -> Can/Permitted), so nothing fixes whether 'could choose' is capability, epistemic or deontic
a proper-noun modifier naming a distinct possessor ('PeopleSoft management') — the naming section covers name-plus-kind, not a name denoting a separate entity the head noun belongs to
new_gaps: a restrictive modifier on a bare-plural GENERIC object has no stated carrier: the plural rules give a fusing classifier the group's kind slot and distribute a descriptive one over members, but a non-specific generic object takes a bare class symbol with no group and no member to distribute to
repair_summary: Replaced the existential witness for the bare plural 'undesired suitors' with a kind-denoting object: (Theme sk_thwart_1 undesired_suitor) plus the compound-kind genus (Inheritance undesired_suitor suitor), dropping (Member sk_suitor_1 suitor) and (Member sk_suitor_1 undesired) — fusing keeps the restriction without asserting either that some undesired suitor exists or that suitors generally are undesired.
notes: The control-verb handling of 'choose to activate', the reduced relative 'designed to thwart ...' with its To purpose atom, and keeping poison_pill undecomposed are correct and untouched.
